stem: Prove that \(\frac{\sin(x+y)}{\sin(x-y)} = \frac{\tan x + \tan y}{\tan x - \tan y}\).
solution:
We have

L.H.S. \(= \frac{\sin(x+y)}{\sin(x-y)} = \frac{\sin x\cos y + \cos x\sin y}{\sin x\cos y - \cos x\sin y}\)

Dividing the numerator and denominator by \(\cos x\cos y\), we get

\(\frac{\sin(x+y)}{\sin(x-y)} = \frac{\tan x + \tan y}{\tan x - \tan y}\).

subtopic: Trigonometric Functions of Sum and Difference of Two Angles
solution:
We know that \(3x = 2x + x\)

Therefore, \(\tan 3x = \tan(2x + x)\)

or \(\tan 3x = \frac{\tan 2x + \tan x}{1 - \tan 2x\tan x}\)

or \(\tan 3x - \tan 3x\tan 2x\tan x = \tan 2x + \tan x\)

or \(\tan 3x - \tan 2x - \tan x = \tan 3x\tan 2x\tan x\)

or \(\tan 3x\tan 2x\tan x = \tan 3x - \tan 2x - \tan x\).

solution:
Using the Identity 20(i), we have

L.H.S. \(= \cos\left(\frac{\pi}{4} + x\right) + \cos\left(\frac{\pi}{4} - x\right)\)

\(= 2\cos\left(\frac{\frac{\pi}{4} + x + \frac{\pi}{4} - x}{2}\right)\cos\left(\frac{\frac{\pi}{4} + x - \left(\frac{\pi}{4} - x\right)}{2}\right)\)

\(= 2\cos\frac{\pi}{4}\cos x = 2 \times \frac{1}{\sqrt{2}}\cos x = \sqrt{2}\cos x = \) R.H.S.

Using the Identities 20(i) and 20(iv), we get

L.H.S. \(= \frac{2\cos\frac{7x + 5x}{2}\cos\frac{7x - 5x}{2}}{2\cos\frac{7x + 5x}{2}\sin\frac{7x - 5x}{2}} = \frac{\cos x}{\sin x} = \cot x = \) R.H.S.

subtopic: Trigonometric Functions of Sum and Difference of Two Angles
solution:
We have

L.H.S. \(= \frac{\sin 5x - 2\sin 3x + \sin x}{\cos 5x - \cos x} = \frac{\sin 5x + \sin x - 2\sin 3x}{\cos 5x - \cos x}\)

\(= \frac{2\sin 3x\cos 2x - 2\sin 3x}{-2\sin 3x\sin 2x} = -\frac{\sin 3x(\cos 2x - 1)}{\sin 3x\sin 2x}\)

\(= \frac{1 - \cos 2x}{\sin 2x} = \frac{2\sin^2 x}{2\sin x\cos x} = \tan x = \) R.H.S.
